Use sci-mathematics/prob-bin instead of the bundled ProB kernel

pkgmetadata.longdescription: ProB2-UI is a modern JavaFX-based user interface for the ProB animator, constraint solver and model checker. It supports the B method, Event-B, CSP-M, TLA+ and Z, offering interactive animation, model checking, LTL/CTL verification, trace recording and replay, and visualisation.
